- **`Company Name*` / `company`**: `text field`. In `BookADemoElements` as `COMPANY_NAME_INPUT`: `enter().companyName(...)`.
- **`Job Title*` / `jobtitle`**: `text field`. In `BookADemoElements` as `JOB_TITLE_INPUT`: `enter().jobTitle(...)`.
- **`Email*` / `email`**: `email field`. In `BookADemoElements` as `EMAIL_INPUT`: `enter().email(...)`.
- **`Phone Number*` / `phone`**: `tel field`. In `BookADemoElements` as `PHONE_NUMBER_INPUT`: `enter().phoneNumber(...)`.
